metadata.name: Clock Signal
metadata.summary: Emulate classic 8-bit and 16-bit computers with automated loading and authentic signal processing

content.value: Clock Signal is an emulator designed to eliminate the learning curves associated with vintage hardware and traditional emulator configurations. Built on modern OpenGL with Qt or SDL backends on Linux, it seeks to be invisible by letting users launch classic games and software directly without manual machine setup.

Through static and runtime analysis of media images, Clock Signal automatically configures the appropriate platform and executes the necessary startup commands while preserving authentic visual and audio fidelity.

items.value: Single-step loading that selects and boots software from disk, tape, or ROM automatically
Authentic signal processing replicating raw composite video decoding and real-time audio filtering
Extensive platform emulation including Acorn Electron, BBC Micro, Apple II, Atari ST, and early Macintosh models
Support for home computer and console systems such as Commodore Vic-20, MSX, Sega Master System, and ZX Spectrum
Fast accelerated loading and minimal latency response during emulation
